name: llm-externalizer
description: CLI that offloads bounded LLM tasks to cheaper local (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp) or remote (OpenRouter) models. Free models by default; profile-based configuration with ensemble mode.

scripts.test: vitest run --exclude 'src/live*.test.ts' --exclude src/broker/broker.test.ts --exclude src/local-fallback-e2e.test.ts --exclude src/broker/broker-governor.test.ts --exclude src/governor/governor-direct.test.ts --exclude src/governor/governor-load.test.ts --exclude src/governor/governor-threads.test.ts --exclude src/governor/governor-burn.test.ts && vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/broker/broker.test.ts src/broker/broker-governor.test.ts src/governor/governor-direct.test.ts src/governor/governor-load.test.ts src/governor/governor-threads.test.ts && vitest run --no-file-parallelism src/governor/governor-burn.test.ts && vitest run src/local-fallback-e2e.test.ts
